name: Fukuhara Izumi
source:
3rd rank captain and cousin of Taira. From the childhood she revere his as an elder brother. His actions and ideas deal a great influence on her. She want to become stout-hearted and right Japanese woman. She took second place in National Championship for Uta-Garuta.

As revere her cousin as elder brother, she tends to do what he says. Not only that, she actually want to follow him up. So tends to [spoiler]be manipulated by him for the sake of achieving his goals (and, as Taira thinks himself, for the sake of Japan).[/spoiler]

"Oh, I am grateful. I am honoured of your Excellency has found it likely."
